strings.plugin_manager.warning: A plugin is program code that runs inside mlaser with your user account's rights. The permissions it declares are enforced on mlaser's own interfaces (network hosts, credentials, the drawing, orders, the queue, the machine), but they are not a sandbox. Enable only plugins you trust, from a source you trust. Changes take effect at the next start.
strings.plugins.title: Plugins
strings.plugins.warning: A plugin is program code that runs inside mlaser with your user account's rights and the machine's authority: it can read and write your files, use the network and command the motion card. The safety guard stops accidents, not a hostile plugin. Enable only plugins you trust, from a source you trust. Changes take effect at the next start.
strings.practice.ask_connect: Practice runs on the simulator only. Connect the simulator now? (The real machine is disconnected.)
strings.practice.error.busy: Finish or abort the running lesson first.
strings.practice.error.load_failed: The practice sheet could not be opened (a job may be running).
strings.practice.error.no_injection: This simulator cannot simulate an alarm.
strings.practice.error.not_simulator: Practice runs only on the simulator. Connect the simulator first (Machine > Connect simulator); the real machine is never used.
strings.practice.none: Choose a lesson and press Start.
strings.practice.state.watching: Your turn: do it on the Run screen. This panel checks it.
strings.practice.step.alarm_read.text: The state is FAULT. Read the alarm list on the Run screen: what happened and the remedy. Find the cause before you reset. On the real machine you would now release the e-stop; the lesson releases it for you.
strings.practice.step.alarm_read.title: Read the alarm
strings.practice.step.alarm_wait.text: Start the cut (arm first). During the cut the lesson presses the simulator's emergency stop: the machine stops and latches a FAULT.
strings.practice.step.alarm_wait.title: Wait for the alarm
strings.practice.step.arm.text: Press Arm laser and confirm. Armed means the laser can fire on START: the state banner turns red.
strings.practice.step.arm.title: Arm the laser
strings.practice.step.continue.text: Press START / CONTINUE (or a Resume button). The head goes back to the breakpoint with the laser off, pierces again and the job goes on.
strings.practice.step.continue.title: Continue
strings.practice.step.done_alarm.text: Well done. Press Stop to drop the stopped job, or practise resuming it in the next lesson.
strings.practice.step.done_alarm.title: Alarm handled
strings.practice.step.finish.text: Let the job run to the end. After the last part the machine is idle again.
strings.practice.step.finish.title: Wait for the end of the job
strings.practice.step.frame.text: Press Frame on the Run screen. The head travels around the job outline with the laser off, so you can see that the job fits on the sheet.
strings.practice.step.frame.title: Frame
strings.practice.step.hold.text: While the job cuts, press HOLD (or Space). The machine stops on the path and keeps a breakpoint: the job is not lost.
strings.practice.step.hold.title: Hold
strings.practice.step.intro_sim: This lesson runs on the simulator: nothing moves and no laser fires. Use the normal Run screen buttons; this panel tells you what to do and checks it.
strings.practice.step.load.text: Press Load to open the practice sheet: three parts on a 300 x 200 mm sheet. Look at it in the live view: the parts, their holes and the start points.
strings.practice.step.load.title: Load the practice sheet
strings.practice.step.loaded.text: The practice sheet is open with cutting parameters on every layer. On the real machine you would now put the sheet on the table and check the material.
strings.practice.step.loaded.title: Sheet loaded
strings.practice.step.pass.text: You did every step of this lesson.
strings.practice.step.pass.title: Lesson passed
strings.practice.step.reset.text: Press Reset alarm. The machine comes back disarmed, with the breakpoint of the stopped job kept.
strings.practice.step.reset.title: Reset
strings.practice.step.resume.text: Arm again, then press Resume: Here (exactly where it stopped) or Contour start (from the start of that contour). The job must finish.
strings.practice.step.resume.title: Resume from the breakpoint
strings.practice.step.start.text: Press START. The pre-flight check runs first; then the job is cut. Watch the progress and the parts turning grey in the live view.
strings.practice.step.start.title: Start the cut
strings.practice.summary: {passed} of {n} lessons passed. Practice jobs never count as production.
strings.practice.title: Practice (simulator)
strings.practice.welcome_text: New to the machine? Six short guided lessons on the built-in simulator: load a sheet, frame, the first cut, hold, alarm handling and resuming from a breakpoint. Nothing is cut and practice runs are not counted as production.

strings.shell.welcome.docs_text: Every workspace, the user modes, themes and keys are described in the user guide (F1). Press Ctrl+K anywhere to find a command, Ctrl+F1 for the keyboard shortcuts.
strings.shell.welcome.heading: Welcome to mlaser
strings.shell.welcome.import_text: Coming from the original Mlaser? Import the machine parameters of your install (its dat folder with HardPara.xml and ManuPara.xml) and the language files of its Lang folder. Nothing is copied from the vendor's program itself.
strings.shell.welcome.intro: An open rebuild of the fiber-laser cutting software. The rail on the left takes you through the work: Design, Process, Nest, Run, Report and Machine.
strings.shell.welcome.safety_text: Every connection starts disarmed: the laser cannot fire until you arm it in the state banner or the run bar, and arming asks for confirmation. Start, Frame and Dry run run a pre-flight check first (travel limits, homing, layers, open contours). While a job runs: Space holds, Esc or F12 stops, from any screen. A fault latches and halts the machine until you reset it.
strings.shell.welcome.sim_text: Practise without a machine: the built-in simulator speaks the real motion-card protocol, so import a drawing, simulate, frame and cut exactly as on the machine. The SIMULATOR chip shows that no machine is connected.
strings.shell.welcome.title: Welcome
strings.shell.ws.design.desc: Draw, import and edit the parts on the canvas
strings.shell.ws.hidden: {workspace} is not available in this user mode

strings.tech.pierce_order: Stages run from the last to the first, then the cut starts (MainApp pierce sequence).
strings.units.help: Every length, speed, acceleration, area and pressure the application shows or takes is in these units. Stored values (documents, settings, the technology database) are always kept in millimetres, so switching never changes a part.
strings.view.measure_result: Measurement: X {dx:.3f} mm, Y {dy:.3f} mm, length {length:.3f} mm

strings.web.warn.text:
The LAN monitor serves a read-only status page (state, progress, alarms, the current sheet) on {host}:{port} to anyone on the network who has the link with its access token. It cannot control the machine. Share the link only with people who may see production data, and keep it off on untrusted networks.

Enable it?

strings.wizard.aborted_text: Aborted: the machine was halted (motion stopped, laser off). Close the wizard or start it again.
strings.wizard.comm.hb_off: No heartbeat output is configured: the watchdog relay cannot work (docs/SAFETY.md §11). Configure it in Machine > Settings > Safety I/O.
strings.wizard.comm.hb_relay_fail: The relay did NOT drop: check its wiring and timeout before any cut.
strings.wizard.comm.hb_relay_ok: Heartbeat on output {output} measured; the relay drops when it stops.
strings.wizard.comm.homing_text: Press Home X/Y: the machine moves to its home switches.
strings.wizard.comm.ilk_configured: Wired: {wired}. Test the wiring in the next step.
strings.wizard.comm.ilk_failed: Failed: {failed} (no signal within 30 s, already active before the test, or it did not clear). Check the wiring, the input number and the alarm level in Safety I/O.
strings.wizard.comm.ilk_no_monitor: This controller has no interlock monitor (no machine connected).
strings.wizard.comm.ilk_none_wired: No interlock is wired; declared not fitted: {declared}.
strings.wizard.comm.ilk_test_text: Start the test, then trigger each wired sensor in turn when the checklist asks for it (open the door, close the gas supply, set the laser source's alarm) and release it again. Each one has 30 s. The machine stays disarmed: nothing moves or fires.
strings.wizard.comm.ilk_tested: Every wired interlock tripped and cleared: {tested}.
strings.wizard.comm.ilk_unconfigured: Not configured: {missing}. These interlocks are not monitored. Wire and configure them in Safety I/O, or declare a sensor this machine does not have.
strings.wizard.comm.interlocks_text: The gas-low, door and laser-source-alarm interlocks and the PC-alive heartbeat (docs/SAFETY.md §8, §11). An interlock that is neither wired nor declared "not fitted" is not monitored: configure it in Safety I/O.
strings.wizard.comm.intro_text: Checks the network, the card's scaling and soft limits, homing, the watchdog heartbeat and the jog directions. A report is saved at the end.
strings.wizard.comm.jog_position: {axis} position went {moved} mm for a +{step} mm jog.
strings.wizard.comm.jog_x_q: Did the head move to the RIGHT (as seen from the operator position)?
strings.wizard.comm.jog_x_text: Press Jog X+: the head moves 10 mm in +X.
strings.wizard.comm.jog_y_q: Did the head move AWAY from you (towards the back of the machine)?
strings.wizard.comm.jog_y_text: Press Jog Y+: the head moves 10 mm in +Y.
strings.wizard.comm.limits_mismatch: The card's soft limits differ on axis {axes}.
strings.wizard.comm.limits_none: The card reports no soft limits.
strings.wizard.comm.limits_ok: The card's soft limits match the axis strokes.
strings.wizard.comm.limits_written: Soft limits written; reconnect to read them back.
strings.wizard.comm.network_text: Network self-test (nothing is sent to the card) and the connection.
strings.wizard.comm.relay_text: Watch the watchdog relay: it is energised now. Press “Hold heartbeat”: the relay must drop (the laser-enable chain opens) within its timeout, about 0.3–0.5 s. Did it drop?
strings.wizard.comm.reverse_set: {key} set to {value}; it takes effect when the parameters are written to the card (reconnect). Repeat this check.
strings.wizard.comm.safety_estop: The emergency stop is within reach and tested.
strings.wizard.comm.safety_source_off: The laser source is switched off (key switch) for the whole checklist.
strings.wizard.comm.scale_mismatch: Card and parameters differ ({which}): card X {card_x} / Y {card_y} p/mm, {card_period_ms} ms; parameters X {par_x} / Y {par_y} p/mm, {par_period_ms} ms.
strings.wizard.comm.scale_ok: X {card_x} p/mm, Y {card_y} p/mm, period {card_period_ms} ms: as the parameters.
strings.wizard.comm.scale_unread: The card's scaling was not read.
strings.wizard.comm.scaling_text: The pulses per mm and the interpolation period the card reports, against the machine parameters.
strings.wizard.comm.soft_limits_text: The soft limits the card reports, against the axis strokes (MAC.SoftLimitMaxLen).
strings.wizard.comm.summary_text: The results are listed above. The report is saved when you finish.
strings.wizard.comm.title: Commissioning checklist
strings.wizard.dry_run: Dry run on the simulator (the real machine is not touched)
strings.wizard.dry_run_tip: Runs every step against a private simulator. Results are shown but never applied.
strings.wizard.edge.applied: Applied: the drawing is rotated by {angle}° (Ctrl+Z undoes it).
strings.wizard.edge.apply_text: Rotate the drawing by the measured angle about the job origin. This is one step in the undo history (Ctrl+Z).
strings.wizard.edge.check_text: Checking the connection, the follower and the parameters…
strings.wizard.edge.error.dock: Edge seek needs a corner dock point (1, 3, 7 or 9), not {dock}.
strings.wizard.edge.error.no_document: No document to apply the rotation to.
strings.wizard.edge.error.no_follower: Edge seek needs the on-board follower (ZF.ZFType is 0).
strings.wizard.edge.error.no_result: There is no measurement to apply.
strings.wizard.edge.error.too_close: The two points are less than 1 mm apart.
strings.wizard.edge.f_current: Start at the current head position
strings.wizard.edge.f_offset_x: Origin offset from the corner, X
strings.wizard.edge.f_offset_y: Origin offset from the corner, Y
strings.wizard.edge.intro_cap3: The capacitive follower finds the sheet edges: two points on one edge and one on the other. The corner and the sheet angle are computed, then you check the result before the drawing is rotated.
strings.wizard.edge.intro_cap4: The capacitive follower finds the sheet edges: two points on each edge. The corner and the sheet angle are computed, then you check the result before the drawing is rotated.
strings.wizard.edge.intro_disc: Jog the head over the disc first. The follower finds three points on the disc rim and the head moves to the centre. You check the result before it is used.
strings.wizard.edge.intro_two_point: Jog the head (red light) to two points on the same sheet edge and record them. The angle of the edge rotates the drawing.
strings.wizard.edge.measure_cap: Press Measure: the head visits each probe point and moves out of the sheet until the follower sees the edge.
strings.wizard.edge.measure_disc: Press Measure: the head moves out in three directions until the follower sees the rim, then to the centre.
strings.wizard.edge.p1_text: Jog the red light to the first point on the sheet edge, then press Record.
strings.wizard.edge.p2_text: Jog to a second point on the same edge, as far from point 1 as possible, then press Record.
strings.wizard.edge.params_text: Where to start and how far apart the probe points are. The defaults are the machine's edge-seek parameters.
strings.wizard.edge.review_text: The measured outline and angle are drawn here and on the canvas (machine coordinates). Press Next to continue, Abort if it looks wrong.
strings.wizard.edge.safety_sheet: The follower must be calibrated and the nozzle clean; the sheet must lie flat on the slats.
strings.wizard.edge.set_origin: Also set the work origin here (coordinate system 1–7)
strings.wizard.error.alarms: {count} alarm(s) are active. Clear them first (Machine › Alarms).
strings.wizard.error.dry_run_unavailable: The dry-run simulator could not start ({detail}). The procedure is now set for the REAL machine; the dry-run box has been cleared.
strings.wizard.error.fault: A fault is latched: {fault}. Reset it first.
strings.wizard.error.job_running: A job is running. Stop or finish it first.
strings.wizard.error.not_connected: The machine is not connected (Machine › Connection).
strings.wizard.error.timeout: Timeout: {what} did not finish within {seconds} s.
strings.wizard.focus.error.none: No autofocus head is configured (AF.AFType = None).
strings.wizard.focus.error.refused: Focus homing was refused (see the log).
strings.wizard.focus.home_text: Press Home focus and wait until it reports homed.
strings.wizard.focus.intro_text: The motorised focus lens moves to its home switch, so its position is known again.
strings.wizard.focus.safety_head: Keep fingers away from the cutting head.
strings.wizard.focus.title: Focus homing
strings.wizard.follower.calibrate_text: Press Calibrate: the follower lowers the head to the sheet and measures. This takes up to a few minutes.
strings.wizard.follower.check_text: Checking that the follower answers and is homed…
strings.wizard.follower.error.no_curve: The follower returned no calibration curve.
strings.wizard.follower.error.not_homed: The follower is not homed. Home Z first (calibration refused, as in the original).
strings.wizard.follower.intro_text: The height follower measures its capacitance curve over the sheet. The new curve is plotted and saved as calib.csv.
strings.wizard.follower.review_text: Raw capacitance over height. It should rise smoothly towards the sheet.
strings.wizard.follower.safety_sheet: Put a clean, flat, grounded metal sheet under the nozzle; the nozzle must be mounted and dry.
strings.wizard.follower.save_text: Save the curve (the previous file is kept as .bak).
strings.wizard.follower.title: Follower calibration
strings.wizard.import.intro: Choose the folder of your Mlaser installation, and the parameter folder (%LOCALAPPDATA%\NexCut, or a copy of it). Preview lists every change; Apply takes the ticked areas. The original installation is only read, never changed.
strings.wizard.import.layers_note: copied; used as the machine layer table
strings.wizard.import.params_placeholder: optional: found automatically in the install folder (dat, NexCut)
strings.wizard.import.title: Import from my Mlaser installation
strings.wizard.import.warn_no_params: No parameter XMLs found: choose the parameter folder (%LOCALAPPDATA%\NexCut).
strings.wizard.laser.arm_confirm:
ARM the machine for the laser test?

Laser emission will be enabled. The work area must be clear, the enclosure closed and everyone wearing laser eyewear.
strings.wizard.laser.arm_text: Arming enables laser emission. Check the safety notes again, then press Arm.
strings.wizard.laser.check_text: Checking: connected, laser enabled, no alarm, pre-flight…
strings.wizard.laser.error.arm_refused: Arming was refused (see the state banner).
strings.wizard.laser.error.dry_run_mode: The laser is disabled (dry-run mode, --laser-off): the test cannot fire.
strings.wizard.laser.error.duration: The pulse length must be between 1 and {max_ms} ms.
strings.wizard.laser.error.levels_text: Duty levels must be numbers separated by commas.
strings.wizard.laser.error.no_levels: Enter at least one duty level.
strings.wizard.laser.error.not_armed: The machine is no longer armed.
strings.wizard.laser.error.pulse: The test pulse ({duty} percent duty) did not run.
strings.wizard.laser.fire_text: Press Fire: one pulse per level, in place.
strings.wizard.laser.intro_text: Short laser pulses in place at the chosen duty levels, e.g. onto a power meter or a scrap sheet. The machine is armed only for this test and disarmed at the end, on Abort and on any error.
strings.wizard.laser.params_text: Duty levels (%) and the pulse length.
strings.wizard.laser.results_text: Enter the measured power for each pulse (optional).
strings.wizard.laser.safety_enclosure: The enclosure and the doors are closed.
strings.wizard.laser.safety_eyewear: Everyone near the machine wears laser safety eyewear for this wavelength.
strings.wizard.laser.safety_people: Nobody is in the beam path or near the cutting head.
strings.wizard.laser.safety_target: A power meter or a scrap sheet is under the nozzle; gas and nozzle are ready.
strings.wizard.laser.title: Laser power test
strings.wizard.running: Running… press Abort (Esc) to stop the machine at once.
strings.wizard.safety.abort: Abort (Esc, F12 or the red button) stops the machine at once.
strings.wizard.safety.clear_area: Keep the work area and the gantry path clear of people and objects.
strings.wizard.safety.head_moves: The cutting head moves down to the sheet and back up.
strings.wizard.safety.heading: Safety
strings.wizard.safety.motion: The axes move in this step. Stay out of the machine; keep a hand near the emergency stop.
strings.wizard.safety.no_laser: The laser is not fired in this procedure.
strings.wizard.warn.not_homed: The machine is not homed: positions are relative to where it was switched on.
strings.ws.machine.hw_note: Changes are checked against the parameter's range and take effect on the card at the next connect.
strings.ws.machine.hw_readonly: Read-only: hardware parameters can be changed in Service mode.
strings.ws.machine.jog_hint: Hold a button to move; release stops. With a step size, one click = one step.
strings.ws.machine.mode_needed: This needs a higher user mode
strings.ws.machine.p_comm: First-connection checklist: network, scaling, soft limits, homing, watchdog, jog directions.
strings.ws.machine.p_edge_cap: Find the sheet corner and angle with the capacitive follower; check the outline, then rotate the drawing (undoable).
strings.ws.machine.p_edge_disc: Find the centre of a round blank with the follower.
strings.ws.machine.p_edge_two: Record two points of a sheet edge with the red light.
strings.ws.machine.p_follower: Calibrate the height follower and save the curve.
strings.ws.machine.p_import: Take parameters, IP addresses, calibration and languages from an existing Mlaser installation.
strings.ws.machine.p_laser: Fire short test pulses at chosen duty levels, with arming and disarming.
strings.ws.machine.selftest_probe: Also send one status request to the card
